displayDescription: Miniature town from a fixed high view: focus pulls from a near van to a far truck as an idea hub links the houses into a system.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: Tilt-shift is approximated with a single-pass depth-aware gather blur (56 taps) whose blur radius comes from linearised scene depth versus a GSAP-keyframed world focus distance; it is not a physical lens simulation, and blurred foreground edges do not spill over sharper background pixels.
The miniature town, vehicles and connection arcs are procedural Three.js primitives with a shadow-mapped sun and hemisphere light; no photographed scene or real tilt-shift footage is used.
Blender was not used, per the user's instruction; Three.js was bundled locally from the existing three 0.187.0 package with local esbuild, with no installs.

STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json is supplied, so the preview demonstrates the catalogue's characteristic action (focus pull along a route from a near moving subject to a far one) rather than a reviewed recipe.
